a_motion: Slow, organic camera drift downwards and rightwards over the three-card stack.
Hard cut at 4.896s to a dynamic diagonal pan over the yellow Recurly card.
b_motion: Linear, robotic camera pan over a flatly staged three-card stack.
Hard cut at 4.896s to a flat, top-down pan over the yellow Recurly card.
absent_in_b: Dramatic perspective convergence and shallow depth of field on the card stack.
Satin specular reflections on the background grid.

differences.a_does: Uses a wide-angle lens close to the cards, creating dramatic perspective convergence and depth.
differences.b_does: Uses a telephoto lens far away, resulting in a flat, orthographic-like appearance.
differences.fix: Decrease camera focal length to 50mm and move the camera closer to the cards to restore perspective depth.

differences.a_does: Features directional key lighting casting soft, realistic contact shadows under the cards.
differences.b_does: Features flat, ambient lighting with weak, indistinct shadows.
differences.fix: Add a directional key light from the top-left and enable high-quality contact shadows with a 15% soft radius.

differences.a_does: Camera pan has smooth, organic ease-in and ease-out curves.
differences.b_does: Camera pan is linear and robotic.
differences.fix: Apply bezier interpolation to camera translation keyframes to match the organic easing.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Match the camera focal length and perspective angle of Video A to eliminate the flat, orthographic look of the card stack.
